name: Citizenship by Origin (Descent)

qualifying_event.description: Article 7 of the Law on Citizenship of the Republic of Serbia grants citizenship by origin to a child if both parents are Serbian citizens at the time of birth; if one parent is a Serbian citizen at birth and the child is born in Serbia; or if one parent is a Serbian citizen, the other parent is unknown or of unknown citizenship or stateless, and the child is born abroad. A child born abroad to only one Serbian-citizen parent (where the other parent is a known foreign citizen) acquires citizenship under Article 9 by being registered with a Serbian diplomatic/consular office before age 18, plus an application to the competent state body. Under Article 12, citizenship acquired by origin is considered held since birth.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's proof of Serbian citizenship; for children born abroad to one Serbian parent, registration with a Serbian diplomatic/consular mission before the child's 18th birthday.

requirements.blocker_text: Both parents are Serbian citizens at the time of the child's birth.

requirement_groups.name: One parent a citizen, child born in Serbia

requirements.blocker_text: One parent is a Serbian citizen at birth and the child is born in the territory of Serbia.

requirement_groups.name: One parent a citizen, child born abroad, registered before 18

requirements.blocker_text: One parent is a Serbian citizen; the child, born abroad, must be registered with a Serbian diplomatic or consular office before turning 18, with an accompanying application to the competent state body.
requirements.fix_path: Register the child with a Serbian embassy/consulate before their 18th birthday.

evidence_required.document: Consular registration (for children born abroad to one citizen parent)

sources.title: Paragraf.rs -- consolidated English text of the Law on Citizenship of the Republic of Serbia, Articles 7, 9 and 12: citizenship by origin (descent) for children of Serbian-citizen parents, including the diplomatic/consular registration route for children born abroad to one citizen parent

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Serbia). Single-generation rule (direct parent-child), consistent with most other countries in this dataset. Distinct from rs_serbian_origin_residence.json (a temporary RESIDENCE permit for anyone with documented Serbian ancestry, of any generational distance) and from rs_citizenship_serbian_origin.json (a direct citizenship-admission route under Article 23 for members of the Serbian people generally, without needing a citizen parent specifically) -- this file covers only the automatic-at-birth descent route for children of an actual Serbian-citizen parent.
